links.outcome: Blinded dietitian ratings of AI-pipeline meal plans versus dietitian-designed plans
links.effect: AI plans scored 3.65 (SD 0.56) vs 3.12 (SD 0.73), d = 0.82; within-evaluator 31 vs 8 favored AI; paired t(39) = 4.72, P < 0.001; plan-level sign-test P = 0.06.
links.quote: AI-generated plans were rated at least as highly as dietitian-designed plans (within-evaluator, 31 vs 8 favored AI; paired t(39) = 4.72, P < 0.001) and higher in all 5 persona pairs, although the plan-level contrast was marginal (sign-test P = 0.06).

unlisted_practices: Constraining LLM choices while software computes nutrient amounts (constrained pipeline architecture) to improve reliability of meal plans

screen.reason: Empirical blinded evaluation of a constrained AI-assisted diet-planning pipeline compared to dietitian-designed plans by 54 professional dietitians across simulated clinical personas.
